notes: Primary use: augment human agents with fast context + one-click tool calls to create/update tickets and trigger refunds via payments API.
Key quote from CPO: 'We need the model to be a trusted action agent — no double refunds, clear audit trail.'
Workload characteristics: high concurrency during promotions. Sustained baseline ~500 req/s for agent assist; expected spike multiplier 4-6x on peak days.
Latency/throughput targets: p95 inference < 350ms for single-step agent suggestions; end-to-end tool-call including orchestration < 1s for urgent refunds.
Failure modes they worry about: duplicate ticket creation, race conditions with external ticketing API, lost callbacks during carrier spikes.
Model preferences: open-model variants allowed; want ability to pin larger model for critical refund flows and cheaper quantized variants for bulk summarization.
Routing/fallback needs: auto-fallback to smaller local model when dedicated capacity saturated; routing by SLA tier (gold/silver customers) and by channel (chat vs voice transcript).
Security: must support SAML SSO for agent console, KMS integration for key management, audit logs for every tool call, and 12-month retention in EU for EU customers.

Integration notes: primary ticketing system is Zendesk (create/update comments, tags, escalation), payments via Stripe + internal refunds service (idempotent endpoint exists), and a custom fraud-check microservice that must be consulted before refunds > $200.
POC scope: implement agent-assist + tool-calling for 'refund < $200' happy path, include simulated Black Friday spike test (5x) and verify no duplicate refunds and observability into each action.

Pricing sensitivity: cost per token important but secondary to reliability for refund workflow; looking for recommendations from Optimize on batching and KV cache to reduce unit cost for summarization jobs.
Open security questions: need sample audit export format, KMS key rotation policy, SOC2 evidence and deployment network diagrams.
Internal champion: VP Customer Ops (Elena Park) - wants SLA for 99.9% uptime during business hours and clear rollback/canary plan.
Sales notes: strong potential for Dedicated or Private contract; likely to start with Dedicated POC and move to Private if InfoSec requires air-gapped components later.
